facts.fact: The DGSN announced the upcoming launch of a "Mon e-ID" mobile app to hold a digital copy of the national ID card, including on phones without NFC.

MAR.note: No link between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding the ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates and maintains the system beyond DGSN running the renewal platforms is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The document describes the electronic national identity card (CNIE) as in use, with renewal ending in an in-person appointment for biometric verification, per the DGSN.
